generalSituation: With the southwesterly airstream moderating, winds will be weak and the weather will be very hot over the coast of Guangdong in the next couple of days, but there will still be a few showers. Meanwhile, a broad trough of low pressure will affect the northern part of the South China Sea to the seas east of Taiwan, and will edge closer to the coast of Guangdong gradually in the middle and latter parts of next week. An area of low pressure may exist over the broad trough of low pressure. Under the influence of the low pressure system, the weather will become unsettled and showers will increase gradually with squally thunderstorms over the coast of southern China in the middle and latter parts of next week.
